name: Commercial Kitchen HACCP Internal Audit Checklist Template
primary_keyword: haccp audit checklist template uk commercial kitchen
secondary_keywords: internal haccp audit checklist catering uk
search_intent: Executive chefs, technical quality managers, and catering supervisors conducting internal food safety audits to verify HACCP principles, CCP monitoring records, and EHO inspection readiness under Regulation (EC) No 852/2004 Article 5.

competitors.name: Food Standards Agency (FSA)
competitors.features: Authoritative legislative advice; text-based guidance without dynamic audit checklists.

competitors.name: High Speed Training
competitors.features: Informative article and static checklist PDF with training course promotion.

competitors.name: SafetyCulture / iAuditor
competitors.features: Software app requiring account creation, subscription, and mobile app download.

competitors.name: Safe Food Pro
competitors.features: Proprietary subscription software ($50+/mo) with no instant web access.

competitors.name: FoodDocs
competitors.features: Paywalled compliance software ($79/mo) hiding tools behind signup.

competitors_lack: No free interactive digital HACCP audit tool with live task verification and temperature logs
No comprehensive 7-principle audit sequence (PRPs, CCP logs, calibration, corrective actions)
No integrated probe calibration verification protocol (ice slush & boiling water)
No watermark-free A4 landscape audit report printable directly from the browser
our_differentiators: Interactive digital HACCP audit checklist with 7 prerequisite and CCP audit categories
Integrated 5-point probe temperature logger with instant pass/fail validation
Statutory Regulation (EC) No 852/2004 Article 5 due diligence compliance framework
Printable A4 audit sign-off sheet with supervisor and EHO audit fields
